title: Tool-Making and Self-Evolving LLM Agents in Low-Latency Systems
abstract: arXiv:2607.08010v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Production LLM agents often waste latency and reliability by regenerating code for the same procedural steps on every request. We replace this inference-time coding loop with an agentic tool-making pipeline that compiles repeated SOP steps into validated, versioned tools before deployment. The tool-maker grounds synthesis in the live environment as it collects execution traces, observes backend schemas and values, generates candidate tools, and repairs them against labeled cases. At runtime, the production agent calls these tools directly and falls back to code generation only when needed. We deploy the approach in a Fulfillment Center alarm-triage system, where an agent diagnoses alarms against a 44-node SOP over heterogeneous metric backends. In production, tool calls reduce p50 latency by 42%. On 1,500 historical alarms, they reduce end-to-end error rate by up to 53% by suppressing run-to-run variance in repeated steps. Beca

translated_title: 低延迟系统中的工具制造与自我进化LLM代理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.08010v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：生产环境中的LLM代理在处理每个请求时，常常因为重复生成相同程序步骤的代码而浪费延迟并降低可靠性。我们将这种推理时的编码循环替换为一种代理工具制造流程，该流程在部署前将重复的标准操作程序（SOP）步骤编译为经过验证的、版本化的工具。工具制造者通过收集执行轨迹、观察后端模式和值、生成候选工具，并针对标注案例进行修复，从而在实际环境中进行合成。在运行时，生产代理直接调用这些工具，仅在需要时回退到代码生成。我们将该方法部署在一个履约中心的警报分诊系统中，该系统代理针对44节点SOP在异构指标后端上诊断警报。在生产环境中，工具调用将p50延迟降低了42%。在1500个历史警报上，通过抑制重复步骤中的运行间差异，端到端错误率降低了高达53%。因为...
tldr: 该论文提出一种工具制造流程，将重复SOP步骤预编译为验证工具，在低延迟生产系统中减少LLM代理的推理开销，显著降低延迟和错误率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a tool-making pipeline that pre-compiles repeated SOP steps into validated tools, reducing LLM agent inference overhead in low-latency systems, significantly lowering latency and error rates.
